# Real-world test models

These models come from Thingiverse and are used unchanged as test inputs. They keep their own licenses, which are separate from this project's MIT license.

| File | Model | Creator | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xyz_cube.stl` | [XYZ 20mm Calibration Cube](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:1278865) | iDig3Dprinting | [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/) |
| `benchy.stl.gz` | [#3DBenchy](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:763622), single-part STL (gzipped) | Creative Tools ([3DBenchy.com](https://www.3dbenchy.com)) | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) (public domain) |
| `benchy_17_parts.stl.gz` | [#3DBenchy](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:763622), "Multi-part - Complete 17 shells" STL (gzipped) | Creative Tools ([3DBenchy.com](https://www.3dbenchy.com)) | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) (public domain) |

The Benchy files are gzipped to keep the repository smaller. The tests unpack them on the fly.
